purpose: Teach: 基幹/分譲/大差/特価/シチュエーション/通算/表題/ラインナップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の基幹となるテーマを明示しろ
lines.en: Ren — make the central theme of your paper explicit.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Sharp attack on the name. Expectation of compliance without softness. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術書の分譲版を取り寄せました
lines.en: Yes. I've ordered the academic distribution edition.
lines.style: Quick, respectful intake of breath. Eager to show progress. Slight rise in pitch on the affirmative. Words delivered crisply, almost like checking boxes. Not defensive, but racing to prove competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、先行研究と大差ない論文では評価されない
lines.en: Ren — a paper that doesn't distinguish itself from prior research won't get recognition.
lines.style: Pause before the main clause. Calm but pointed. The words land with weight. Not harsh, but unyielding. A teaching moment wrapped in directiveness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の特価参加プランを利用します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make use of the conference's discount participation plan.
lines.style: Slightly breathless affirmative. Scrambling just slightly beneath the surface politeness. Nodding while speaking. The sound of someone taking mental notes and racing ahead to the next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験のシチュエーションを変えて検証しろ
lines.en: Ren — change the experimental parameters and verify your results.
lines.style: Firm anchor on the name. Commanding but not harsh. Each clause separate and intentional. The rhythm of someone used to being followed through instructions without question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。引用回数の通算データを更新しました
lines.en: Yes. I've updated the citation count database.
lines.style: Immediate, clipped affirmative. Demonstrating readiness. The pace quickens slightly. Efficient word choice. The tone of someone trying to keep pace with high expectations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の表題を慎重に決めろ
lines.en: Ren — choose your paper's title with deliberate care.
lines.style: Slight pause before the main instruction. Weight on 'deliberate.' The tone of someone who knows this detail matters more than students realize. Expectant, measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文集のラインナップを充実させます
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen the paper collection lineup.
lines.style: Clipped, almost closing affirmative. Slight exhale of resignation at the end. Fast pace throughout. The sound of someone running down a checklist, energy beginning to flag slightly but resolve still intact.
